engemedical.location: Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil · Remote
engemedical.description:
I work as a Full-Stack Developer and AI Automation Developer Intern at Engemedical Brasil, a healthcare consultancy with more than 10 years of experience.

I contribute to the development and evolution of the company’s new web platform, using Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend and NestJS on the backend. I build new pages, implement features, work on integrations, and continuously contribute to the evolution of the product.

I also develop commercial automation workflows with n8n, including automated SDRs, active prospecting, and WhatsApp-based customer service. These solutions help reduce friction in commercial processes and improve operational efficiency.

In addition, I create educational courses using HeyGen, producing videos with digital avatars and AI-cloned personas.

dentalis.title: Frontend Developer | Freelance Project
dentalis.description:
Developed two institutional landing pages for dental clinics from the same business group, located in Blumenau and Joinville, Brazil.

Built the projects with Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI, creating responsive and modern interfaces aligned with each clinic’s visual identity.

The pages were structured with a focus on technical SEO, semantic structure, performance, indexing, and converting visitors into potential patients.

vip.company: VIP Administradora de Bens e Condomínios
vip.description: Built the professional Landing Page for VIP, a property management company. Used React + TypeScript + ShadCN UI, and handled full deployment via cPanel including domain redirection and complete product delivery.

frilic.description: Built an automated WhatsApp Chatbot for a medical clinic as one of 3 developers. I owned the backend — the chatbot itself — using Node.js + TypeScript with whatsapp-web.js, node-notifier, and qrcode-terminal. The bot automated scheduling, viewing, and cancellation, cutting costs and improving service.

pompeia.description: Built a Landing Page and WhatsApp Chatbot for a beauty salon. The Landing Page used Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS in a monorepo setup. The chatbot was an improved version of a previous project — added caching, push notifications via NTFY, and whatsapp-web.js integration.

vem.company: Vem com a Gente - Agência de Viagens
vem.description: Built an automated WhatsApp Chatbot for a travel agency using Node.js with whatsapp-web.js, node-notifier, and qrcode-terminal. The bot automated support and sales, fully customizable per client needs.
vem.testimonial: I really want to thank you for the work you did. The bot turned out great, did exactly what I needed without any hassle. I saw how dedicated you were, testing everything, fixing bugs, and even pulling all-nighters to finish. It turned out really well and sped up my client service a lot. If anyone asks, I'll recommend you without thinking twice!
